record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.original_question: Is the complex hyperbolic horseshoe locus HC connected?

evidence.quote: Question 27. — Is the locus HC connected?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For complex parameters $(a,c)\in\mathbb{C}^*\times\mathbb{C}$, consider the complex Hénon map
$$f_{a,c}:\mathbb{C}^2\to\mathbb{C}^2,\qquad f_{a,c}(x,y)=(x^2+c-ay,\;x).$$
Let $K_{a,c}=\{p\in\mathbb{C}^2 : \{f_{a,c}^n(p)\}_{n\in\mathbb{Z}} \text{ is bounded}\}$ and let $J_{a,c}=\partial K_{a,c}$. Say that $f_{a,c}$ is a (complex) hyperbolic horseshoe if the nonwandering set of $f_{a,c}$ is contained in $J_{a,c}$, is hyperbolic, and the restriction of $f_{a,c}$ to this nonwandering set is topologically conjugate to the full two-sided shift on two symbols. Define the complex hyperbolic horseshoe locus
$$\mathcal{H}_{\mathbb{C}} = \{(a,c)\in\mathbb{C}^*\times\mathbb{C} : f_{a,c} \text{ is a hyperbolic horseshoe}\}.$$
Is $\mathcal{H}_{\mathbb{C}}$ connected as a subset of $\mathbb{C}^*\times\mathbb{C}$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the complex hyperbolic horseshoe locus of the Hénon family is connected is a long-standing open problem, often associated with Hubbard. Work by Arai, Bedford-Smillie, and others has characterized parts of this locus symbolically and shown the existence of nontrivial loops with infinitely many distinct monodromies, but no result establishing or disproving connectedness of the full horseshoe locus appears in the literature.

status_evidence.title: A Symbolic Characterization of the Horseshoe Locus in the Hénon Family
status_evidence.snippet: Symbolic characterization of horseshoe parameters in the Hénon family; structural results about the locus.
status_evidence.claim: Active research characterizes the horseshoe locus symbolically but does not resolve its global connectedness.

status_evidence.title: On Loops in the Hyperbolic Locus of the Complex Hénon Map and Their Monodromies
status_evidence.snippet: Existence of nontrivial loops in the hyperbolic locus producing infinitely many distinct monodromies.
status_evidence.claim: The complex hyperbolic locus has rich topology, but connectedness of the horseshoe component remains unsettled.

status_evidence.title: On Parameter Loci of the Hénon Family
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the parameter loci of the Hénon family including hyperbolic horseshoe regions.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys parameter loci without proving connectedness of the complex horseshoe locus.
